title: Advancing biosecurity: progress and prospects of volatile organic compound (VOC) detection for invasive pest and pathogen surveillance
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00370A, Review Article
Open Access

Farjana Haque, Fatema Zerin Farhana, Milkiyas Toru Tantu, Md Akeruzzaman Shaon, Geoff M. Gurr, Muhammad J. A. Shiddiky
This review highlights VOC-based approaches for early detection of H. halys, using analytical and sensor-based platforms to enable timely pest identification, supports surveillance, and strengthens global crop biosecurity.
